children: Ansell keeps its bear at Citi despite easing input costs and improving margins. Analyst Laura Sutcliffe acknowledges that the personal protective equipment maker's input costs have cooled since the end of June, but tells clients in a note that they remain elevated. She says Ansell's margins are trending in the right direction, but points out that this is already captured by consensus forecasts. Citi keeps a sell rating on the stock with a target price of 39.50 Australian dollars. Shares are up 0.5% at A$45.88. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
